query: Generate an API key for my Turnkey organization using the CLI
expected_behavior: Uses turnkey generate api-key with --organization flag
Shows where key files are stored (~/.config/turnkey/keys/)
Mentions the public key output for registration

query: Create a new user with an API key via the Turnkey API
expected_behavior: Includes proper JSON body with userName and apiKeys array

query: Set up a sub-organization with a root user for a new customer
expected_behavior: Includes rootUsers with userName and apiKeys

query: Generate an encryption key for exporting a wallet
expected_behavior: Explains encryption keys are for secure wallet import/export

query: Set up a sub-organization with a root user and wallet for a new customer
expected_behavior: Includes rootUsers with API key configuration
Optionally includes wallet in the sub-org creation

query: How do I set up the turnkey CLI tool for the first time?
expected_behavior: Explains turnkey generate api-key with --organization flag
